entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I... I need to return something. I think. I'm just so confused by the whole process.
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, could I have your name and order number, please?
Yes, it's Mark Sterling. The order number is... uh... VF88675. It's for a helmet.
Thank you, Mark. I see the order for the Aero-Vent helmet here, delivered about 40 days ago. Can you tell me, what specifically is the issue with it? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Oh, no, nothing's broken. It's just... the color. It looked different on the website. I ordered it for my son, and he just doesn't like it. The box is still unopened, I haven't even touched it.
I understand. Getting the right gear is important, especially when it comes to safety equipment like a helmet. You want to be sure you'll use it.
Exactly! I just saw the box and knew the color was wrong. I feel so helpless with these things. Can't you just help me send it back?
Of course, Mark. Let me just pull up our return policy information for you. One moment.

Okay, I've checked for you. Since the item was delivered 40 days ago, it's well within our 90-day return window. And since the box is unopened, that makes it even easier. We can definitely process a full refund for that helmet.
Oh! Really? That's... that's a relief. I was so worried it had been too long. Thank you.

You're very welcome. I'm happy to help. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email on file now. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it at any post office. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that's perfect. Thank you so much, Sarah. You've made this much less confusing.
My pleasure, Mark. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
